images.prompt:
Original premium Christmas greeting-card illustration in hand-painted storybook watercolour on subtly textured cold-pressed paper; full colour with muted ivory, winter blue-grey, pine and sage, warm brown, restrained berry red, and antique-gold accents. Soft translucent pigment layers, lightly mottled washes, dry-brush texture, gentle granular highlights and occasional diffused light flecks. Predominantly painterly and outline-free, with sparse fine broken pencil-like marks only for delicate texture and definition. Render characters, when present, with softly rounded believable anatomy, mildly enlarged expressive eyes and tender natural facial modelling. Medium-to-high focal detail, softened low-contrast supporting detail, graceful framing shapes, legible text space, diffuse warm glow and gentle shadow modelling; cosy, nostalgic, quietly magical handmade print feel.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Original hand-painted storybook watercolour for a premium Christmas greeting card, balancing tender naturalism with gentle festive fantasy.; line weight: Mostly outline-free, with only very fine, intermittent pencil-like detail marks for texture and definition.; line quality: Organic, softly broken and directional; painted edges feather naturally into the paper rather than forming crisp digital contours.; detail level: Medium to high detail, concentrated on the focal forms and a small number of atmospheric festive accents; distant or supporting elements remain soft and simplified for reliable home printing.; character language: Appealing, broadly believable woodland-animal anatomy with softly rounded forms, mildly enlarged expressive eyes, delicate facial modelling, and calm, kind expressions.; background density: Flexible from airy paper-led space to an intimate layered vignette; backgrounds use softened depth, low-contrast receding detail, and clear areas for readable wording.; composition: One unmistakable focal hierarchy with the greeting integrated as a deliberate part of the design; use framing curves, negative space, and selective decorative accents rather than evenly distributing detail across the card.; palette: Muted traditional Christmas hues: cream and ivory, blue-grey winter tones, pine and sage greens, warm woodland browns, restrained berry red, and concentrated antique-gold highlights.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Layered translucent washes and soft tonal modelling, with subtle dry-brush definition, diffuse warm glows, gentle rim light, and no hard-edged cel shading.; texture: Visible cold-pressed watercolour paper grain, lightly mottled pigment blooms, restrained dry-brush marks, granular snowy highlights, and occasional soft bokeh-like flecks.; mood: Cosy, nostalgic, tender and quietly magical, with a refined handmade feel suited to seasonal gifting..

PAGE 1 of "Robin at the Frosted Gate" (card-front): Portrait card front. A European robin perched on the top rail of a weathered frosted cottage-garden gate in the lower half, prominent holly sprig with red berries and frosted sage greenery framing the lower edge, pale peach winter sunrise sky opening above, soft distant blue-grey garden hints, a few subtle snow flecks. Exact title text in upper third: “Merry Christmas” in antique-gold serif lettering.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with an illustrated background that is part of the artwork. The artwork runs to every edge (full bleed). Keep all text and key elements inside a comfortable inner safe area. It must look like a finished, retail-quality greeting card design, not a colouring page or worksheet. Create coordinated portrait card panels with clear, high-contrast space for the front greeting and inside message, suitable for A4 or US Letter folding. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Copying any supplied reference composition, character, costume, prop combination, scene arrangement, lettering, greeting wording arrangement, border, mock-up, envelope, product photography or staging; The front-facing dressed rabbit portrait with green holly-trimmed hat and snowflake scarf; A squirrel holding a sparkler on a decorated snowy branch with lantern and village setting; Mice in Santa hats at an arched doorway beside a decorated tree; Photorealism or CGI rendering; Generic clip-art or flat vector aesthetics; Bright neon or harsh primary Christmas colours; Hard cel shading, heavy black outlines or overly clean digital linework; Overcrowded details that compete with the greeting; Ink-heavy near-black background coverage unsuitable for typical home printers; Tiny details or hairline marks essential to understanding the image; Poor text contrast, illegible typography or misspelled text; Trademarked characters, logos or brand-associated imagery.
